story.title: Anthropic's Mythos AI finds hundreds of high-severity security bugs in Firefox, reshaping Mozilla's cybersecurity approach
story.summary: Mozilla security researchers report that Anthropic's Mythos AI model has uncovered a large number of high-severity vulnerabilities in the Firefox browser codebase, significantly outpacing traditional manual and automated auditing methods. The discovery has prompted Mozilla to restructure its internal security workflow around AI-assisted bug detection. The development signals a broader shift in how open-source projects may use frontier AI models to harden widely-used software.
